note: ICV1 identities of the curves of the complete DLPs, computed with scripts/curve_id.py extension (modulus t^5 - 2, i.e. c_0 = p - 2). Not registered: build_curve_registry.py harvests no extension-field JSON (problems/k5-joux-vitse-trial-cost-and-fpk-ecbench.md). Ladder curves have no counted order (p^5 up to 8e11) and so no identity; they are named by (p, seed) and their coefficients in data/ladder/.
